mapper.sql: command_id, task_id, vehicle_id, status, failure_reason, completed_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transport_command (command_id, task_id, vehicle_id, status, failure_reason, completed_at, created_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{taskId}, #{vehicleId}, #{status}, #{failureReason}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM transport_command WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, command_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM transport_command WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PUBLISHED')
mapper.update: UPDATE transport_command SET status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND status = 'CREATED'
